outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram/table of breast anatomy and cancer classification, not a plot.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating the study aim, not a plot.
Panel C is a schematic showing the experimental setup for luciferase recordings, not a plot.
Panel D shows illustrative line plots of oscillating signals; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E is an illustrative heatmap of correlation values; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F shows an illustrative line plot of cell number over days; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G shows an illustrative dose-response line plot; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel H shows an illustrative heatmap of gene expression/mutation data; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel I shows illustrative scatter plots (PCA and 3D parameter space); scatter plots inherently show individual points and are exempt.
